sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被放干了。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，知道了她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“档案档案”呈现的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode was originally released on Casefile's Patreon, Apple Premium, and Spotify Premium feeds as an early bonus for our paid subscribers.
sentences.zh: 本期节目最初发布于“档案档案”的Patreon、Apple Premium和Spotify Premium频道，作为给付费订阅者的早期福利。

sentences.en: These episodes are designed to be slightly shorter, allowing us to cover a broader range of cases.
sentences.zh: 这些单集的设计稍短一些，使我们能够涵盖更广泛的案件。

sentences.en: To receive these episodes early and ad-free, you can support Casefile on your preferred platform.
sentences.zh: 想要提前且无广告收听这些节目，您可以在您喜爱的平台上支持“档案档案”。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of Monday, March 21, 1977, 33-year-old Mary Gillespie walked out of her house and down the long dirt path to the mailbox.
sentences.zh: 1977年3月21日星期一下午，33岁的玛丽·吉莱斯皮走出了家门，沿着长长的泥土小路走向信箱。

sentences.en: The Gillespie Farmhouse was the only residence visible on this area of road on the outskirts of Circleville, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 吉莱斯皮农舍是俄亥俄州瑟克尔维尔郊区这片道路上唯一能看到的住宅。

sentences.en: Across the street, acres of flat cropland extended as far as the eye could see.
sentences.zh: 马路对面，一亩亩平坦的农田一望无际。

sentences.en: The cool air was quiet and still.
sentences.zh: 清凉的空气宁静而凝固。

sentences.en: After retrieving the mail, Mary absentmindedly flicked through it while walking back to the front door.
sentences.zh: 取回信件后，玛丽在走回前门的同时，心不在焉地翻看着它们。

sentences.en: Then an envelope caught her eye.
sentences.zh: 这时，一个信封引起了她的注意。

sentences.en: Her name and address were written on it in thick black ink with stocky square lettering.
sentences.zh: 她的名字和地址是用粗黑的墨水和厚实的方形字母写在上面的。

sentences.en: Mary turned it over.
sentences.zh: 玛丽把它翻过来。

sentences.en: There was no return address.
sentences.zh: 上面没有回信地址。

sentences.en: Mary opened the envelope.
sentences.zh: 玛丽打开了信封。

sentences.en: Inside was a single sheet of lined paper.
sentences.zh: 里面只有一张横格纸。

sentences.en: Written in the same blocky handwriting, one line of the letter immediately caught Mary's eye.
sentences.zh: 信上写着同样粗体的手写字，其中一行字立刻抓住了玛丽的目光。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着：

sentences.en: Once Mary Gillespie was back indoors, she studied the letter more closely.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·吉莱斯皮回到屋内后，更加仔细地研究了这封信。

sentences.en: Mary knew who the writer was referring to.
sentences.zh: 玛丽知道写信人指的是谁。

sentences.en: 44-year-old Gordon Massey was the district's school superintendent and Mary did know him.
sentences.zh: 44岁的戈登·梅西是学区总监，玛丽确实认识他。

sentences.en: She and Gordon worked in close quarters because Mary was a school bus driver.
sentences.zh: 她和戈登工作接触很近，因为玛丽是一名校车司机。

sentences.en: Recently, rumours had circulated throughout the tight-knit community of Circleville that Gordon and Mary were having an affair.
sentences.zh: 最近，在紧密团结的瑟克尔维尔社区里流传着谣言，称戈登和玛丽有染。

sentences.en: Whoever had sent the letter was imploring Mary to break off her alleged relationship with the married superintendent and report him to the school board.
sentences.zh: 无论谁寄出了这封信，都在恳求玛丽断绝她与这位已婚总监的所谓关系，并向学校董事会举报他。

sentences.en: The letter had no identifying features.
sentences.zh: 这封信没有任何可资识别的特征。

sentences.en: It had been postmarked from the state capital of Columbus, which was approximately 30 miles away.
sentences.zh: 它盖有大约30英里外的州首府哥伦布的邮戳。

sentences.en: Mary was concerned by the letter but decided not to do anything about it.
sentences.zh: 玛丽对这封信感到担忧，但决定不做任何处理。

sentences.en: She stashed it away in a safe place where her husband and two children wouldn't find it.
sentences.zh: 她把它藏在了一个安全的地方，她的丈夫和两个孩子找不到那里。

sentences.en: A week later, Mary found another envelope in the mailbox with the same distinctive blocky writing in thick black ink.
sentences.zh: 一周后，玛丽在信箱里发现另一个信封，上面同样写着醒目的粗黑体字。

sentences.en: Once again, it was postmarked from Columbus with no return address.
sentences.zh: 同样，邮戳来自哥伦布，且没有回信地址。

sentences.en: Inside was another sheet of lined paper.
sentences.zh: 里面是另一张横格纸。

sentences.en: This time, the message was more aggressive.
sentences.zh: 这一次，语气更加具有攻击性。

sentences.en: Lady, this is your last chance to report him.
sentences.zh: 太太，这是你举报他的最后机会。

sentences.en: A pig sneaks around and meets other women's husbands behind their backs and causes families and homes and marriages to suffer.
sentences.zh: 一个卑鄙小人鬼鬼祟祟，背着别人跟有夫之妇鬼混，害得家庭和婚姻饱受折磨。

sentences.en: On this occasion, the mysterious author referenced Mary's eight-year-old daughter, Tracy.
sentences.zh: 这一次，神秘的作者提到了玛丽八岁的女儿特雷西。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 原话是：

sentences.en: How is your little girl?
sentences.zh: 你的小女孩怎么样了？

sentences.en: Will she grow up to be like you?
sentences.zh: 她长大后会变成你这样吗？

sentences.en: Mary tucked the disturbing letter away with the previous one and tried to put it out of her mind.
sentences.zh: 玛丽把这封令人不安的信和前一封夹在一起，尽量不去想它。

sentences.en: Almost one week later, Mary Gillespie's husband, Ron, was at the glass plate factory where he worked when he received a letter that was addressed to him in thick, blocky writing.
sentences.zh: 大约一周后，玛丽·吉莱斯皮的丈夫罗恩正在他工作的玻璃板厂上班时，收到了一封用粗体字写给他的信。

sentences.en: Postmarked from Columbus with no return address, the letter informed Ron that his wife was having an affair with Superintendent Gordon Massey.
sentences.zh: 信件邮戳来自哥伦布，没有回信地址，信中告知罗恩他的妻子与总监戈登·梅西有染。

sentences.en: Its author urged Ron to expose them, concluding with the suggestion,
sentences.zh: 其作者敦促罗恩揭发他们，并在最后建议道：

sentences.en: You should catch them together and kill them both.
sentences.zh: 你应该把他们抓个正着，然后把两人都杀了。

sentences.en: When Ron got home from work, he confronted his wife with the letter.
sentences.zh: 罗恩下班回家后，拿着这封信质问妻子。

sentences.en: Mary told him the accusation wasn't true and revealed that she had also received two letters.
sentences.zh: 玛丽告诉他指控并非事实，并透露自己也收到了两封信。

sentences.en: She took them out from where she'd stashed them and the couple compared them.
sentences.zh: 她把信从藏身处拿出来，夫妻俩进行了对比。

sentences.en: There were definite similarities between the three letters.
sentences.zh: 这三封信之间有着明显的相似之处。

sentences.en: Aside from the handwriting, they were all riddled with spelling and grammatical errors.
sentences.zh: 除了字迹之外，它们都充斥着拼写和语法错误。

sentences.en: The writer also had the unique habit of using colons in place of full stops.
sentences.zh: 写信人还有一个用冒号代替句号的独特习惯。

sentences.en: Ron was concerned but agreed with Mary to keep the letters under wraps.
sentences.zh: 罗恩感到担忧，但同意与玛丽一起对这些信件保密。

sentences.en: Circleville was already rife with gossip and speculation as it was.
sentences.zh: 瑟克尔维尔本就充斥着各种流言蜚语和猜测。

sentences.en: A fortnight later, on Thursday April 14, Ron received another note from his wife's unidentified harasser.
sentences.zh: 两周后，即4月14日星期四，罗恩又收到了来自他妻子不明骚扰者的便条。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着：

sentences.en: Good hunting in your red and white truck on your way to work.
sentences.zh: 祝你开着红白相间的卡车去上班时好运。

sentences.en: Let her read this, it is no lie.
sentences.zh: 让她读读这个，这不是谎言。

sentences.en: I followed Gordon Massey for weeks and have seen her meet him several times.
sentences.zh: 我跟踪戈登·梅西好几周了，看见她和他碰面好几次。

sentences.en: He knows what I want.
sentences.zh: 他知道我想要什么。

sentences.en: When he quits, I'll go away.
sentences.zh: 等他辞职了，我就会离开。

sentences.en: Your life is in danger.
sentences.zh: 你的生命正处于危险之中。

sentences.en: This letter featured one notable difference to its predecessors.
sentences.zh: 这封信与前几封信有一个显著的不同之处。

sentences.en: There was a return address printed on the back of the envelope listing a house in Circleville.
sentences.zh: 信封背面印有一个回信地址，列出了瑟克尔维尔的一处住宅。

sentences.en: Ron and Mary looked it up, only to find it was the home of Superintendent Gordon Massey.
sentences.zh: 罗恩和玛丽查了一下，却发现那是总监戈登·梅西的家。

sentences.en: It appeared the writer was mocking them.
sentences.zh: 写信人似乎在嘲弄他们。

sentences.en: Ron was unnerved by the writer's threats.
sentences.zh: 罗恩对写信人的威胁感到不安。

sentences.en: The mention of his red and white pickup truck indicated that he was being watched.
sentences.zh: 提到他的红白相间皮卡车表明他一直在被监视。

sentences.en: This led to Ron and Mary reporting the letters to the county sheriff's office.
sentences.zh: 这导致罗恩和玛丽向县警长办公室报了案。

sentences.en: Sheriff Dwight Radcliffe looked over the letters.
sentences.zh: 德怀特·拉德克利夫警长查看了这些信件。

sentences.en: They featured absolutely no clues as to the writer's identity.
sentences.zh: 它们完全没有透露写信人身份的线索。

sentences.en: Sheriff Radcliffe reached out to the district's school officials and the US Postal Service in the hopes they could help establish a lead.
sentences.zh: 拉德克利夫警长联系了学区官员和美国邮政服务局，希望能帮助找到线索。

sentences.en: While the school officials cooperated, the Postal Service did not.
sentences.zh: 虽然学校官员进行了配合，但邮政部门没有。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Mary Gillespie continued to receive letters.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，玛丽·吉莱斯皮继续收到信件。

sentences.en: Worryingly, the author began directing their anger at Mary's eight-year-old daughter, Tracy, writing,
sentences.zh: 令人担忧的是，作者开始将愤怒转向玛丽八岁的女儿特雷西，写道：

sentences.en: I shall come out there and put a bullet in that little girl's head.
sentences.zh: 我要去那里，给那个小女孩的脑袋上一枪。

sentences.en: Unbeknown to Ron and Mary Gillespie, they weren't the only people in town to receive mail from the Circleville letter writer.
sentences.zh: 罗恩和玛丽·吉莱斯皮并不知道，他们并不是镇上唯一收到瑟克尔维尔写信人邮件的人。

sentences.en: Although the writer seemed to have Mary Gillespie firmly in their sights, other residents began reporting similar letters to the sheriff.
sentences.zh: 尽管写信人似乎死死盯上了玛丽·吉莱斯皮，但其他居民也开始向警长报告类似的信件。

sentences.en: Most were regarded as a nuisance and nothing more.
sentences.zh: 大多数都被视为无聊骚扰，仅此而已。

sentences.en: But then, Superintendent Gordon Massey came forward.
sentences.zh: 但随后，总监戈登·梅西站了出来。

sentences.en: Two weeks before Mary Gillespie received her first letter, Gordon Massey had found a note in his mail.
sentences.zh: 在玛丽·吉莱斯皮收到第一封信的两周前，戈登·梅西在信箱里发现了一张便条。

sentences.en: It featured the same block handwriting as the others, with errors in spelling and grammar, no return address, and a Columbus postmark.
sentences.zh: 它具有与其他信件相同的粗体字迹，拼写和语法有错误，没有回信地址，且盖有哥伦布邮戳。

sentences.en: As detailed in the podcast Whatever Remains, the letter accused Gordon Massey of harassing numerous female bus drivers.
sentences.zh: 正如播客《无论剩下什么》中所详述的那样，这封信指责戈登·梅西骚扰多名女性公交车司机。

sentences.en: An excerpt read,
sentences.zh: 其中一段摘录写道：

sentences.en: To prey on another man's girl is untouchable, especially when they're out trying to make a living.
sentences.zh: 捕食别人的女友是不可原谅的，尤其是当她们出来谋生的时候。

sentences.en: I suggest you find yourself a pimple-faced whore and start up with her and leave my girls alone.
sentences.zh: 我建议你去找个满脸青春痘的婊子跟她好，别管我的女孩们。

sentences.en: Gordon had initially decided to keep the note to himself, but eventually brought it to the attention of authorities.
sentences.zh: 戈登最初决定将这张便条藏在心里，但最终还是将它提请当局注意。

sentences.en: They soon found that shortly after this letter was sent, the writer had also sent letters to the local board of education and the superintendent of another school district.
sentences.zh: 他们很快发现，在这封信寄出后不久，写信人还向当地教育委员会和另一个学区的总监寄了信。

sentences.en: All of these letters demanded that Gordon Massey step down from his superintendent position and leave the bus drivers alone.
sentences.zh: 所有这些信件都要求戈登·梅西辞去总监职务，并放过那些女公交车司机。

sentences.en: The content of the letters implied that the author was close to the bus drivers, but there were no other clues as to their identity.
sentences.zh: 信件的内容暗示作者与女公交车司机很近，但没有其他关于其身份的线索。

sentences.en: Law enforcement had no evidence that Gordon Massey was acting inappropriately towards the female bus drivers, and he retained his job.
sentences.zh: 执法部门没有证据表明戈登·梅西对女公交车司机有不当行为，他保住了工作。

sentences.en: Signs then started cropping up along the sides of roads on Mary Gillespie's bus route.
sentences.zh: 随后，玛丽·吉莱斯皮公交车路线的路边开始出现标语。

sentences.en: They featured crude messages accusing Mary and Gordon Massey of having an affair.
sentences.zh: 它们上面写着粗俗的信息，指责玛丽和戈登·梅西有染。

sentences.en: They also claimed that Mary's underage daughter, Tracy, was having sexual relations with the superintendent.
sentences.zh: 他们还声称玛丽未成年女儿特雷西与总监发生性关系。

sentences.en: Ron Gillespie woke up early each morning so he could drive around town looking for new signs.
sentences.zh: 罗恩·吉莱斯皮每天清晨醒来，开车在镇上寻找新的标语。

sentences.en: Whenever he found one, he promptly tore it down and destroyed it.
sentences.zh: 每当他找到一个，就立即把它扯下来销毁。

sentences.en: The constant harassment was taking a toll on him and Mary.
sentences.zh: 不断的骚扰让他和玛丽筋疲力尽。

sentences.en: They became tired, fearful, and were constantly on the lookout for the next accusation.
sentences.zh: 他们变得疲惫、恐惧，时刻提防着下一次指控。

sentences.en: Despite Ron Gillespie's vigilance, the letters and signs increased in frequency.
sentences.zh: 尽管罗恩·吉莱斯皮保持警惕，但信件和标语出现的频率却越来越高。

sentences.en: It seemed as though the sheriff's office had little interest in identifying the culprit.
sentences.zh: 警长办公室似乎对揪出罪魁祸首毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: Desperate for help, Ron and Mary reached out to Ron's sister, Karen Freshour, and her husband, Paul.
sentences.zh: 急需帮助的罗恩和玛丽找到了罗恩的姐姐卡伦·弗雷舒尔及其实际丈夫保罗。

sentences.en: Although they couldn't be certain, the Gillespie's had a hunch as to who was behind the letters.
sentences.zh: 虽然无法确定，但吉莱斯皮夫妇对幕后黑手有直觉。

sentences.en: They believed it was another bus driver named David Longberry.
sentences.zh: 他们认为那是另一个名叫大卫·朗伯里的公交车司机。

sentences.en: Before the letters arrived, David had made advances towards Mary despite knowing she was married.
sentences.zh: 在信件到来之前，大卫在明知玛丽已婚的情况下向她示好。

sentences.en: After Mary rejected David, he began to act coolly towards her.
sentences.zh: 在玛丽拒绝大卫后，他开始对她冷淡起来。

sentences.en: It appeared as though he held a grudge.
sentences.zh: 他似乎心存怨恨。

sentences.en: One day in mid-1977, Ron and Mary hatched a plan with help from Karen and Paul Freshour.
sentences.zh: 1977年中期的一天，罗恩和玛丽在卡伦和保罗·弗雷舒尔的帮助下制定了一个计划。

sentences.en: Paul was a former prison guard and so was used to dealing with threatening behaviour.
sentences.zh: 保罗曾是一名狱警，因此习惯了应对威胁行为。

sentences.en: Nine years earlier, he'd been working at the Ohio State Penitentiary when a riot broke out.
sentences.zh: 九年前，当俄亥俄州立监狱爆发暴动时，他正在那里工作。

sentences.en: Paul was held hostage for 30 hours alongside eight other guards.
sentences.zh: 保罗与其他八名警卫一起被劫为人质30小时。

sentences.en: Although he escaped the ordeal physically unharmed, Paul subsequently quit his job.
sentences.zh: 虽然他在这次磨难中安然无恙地逃脱了，但保罗随后还是辞去了工作。

sentences.en: Almost a decade later, he still remembered the tactics he'd used trying to de-escalate the situation and suggested they employ them against the letter-writer.
sentences.zh: 将近十年后，他依然记得自己试图缓和局势时使用的策略，并建议将它们用在写信人身上。

sentences.en: Paul Freshour drafted a letter to David Longberry with assistance from Ron, Mary and his wife, Karen.
sentences.zh: 在罗恩、玛丽和他的妻子卡伦的协助下，保罗·弗雷舒尔起草了一封给大卫·朗伯里的信。

sentences.en: Paul later said that the letter wasn't violent in nature, but it ordered David to stop writing the letters and posting signs around town.
sentences.zh: 保罗后来表示，这封信本质上并不暴力，但它命令大卫停止写信和在镇上张贴标语。

sentences.en: Paul mailed the letter to David.
sentences.zh: 保罗把信寄给了大卫。

sentences.en: He later followed it up with three or four more.
sentences.zh: 他随后又跟进了三四封。

sentences.en: The letters stopped immediately after this, but the Gillespie's relief was short-lived.
sentences.zh: 信件在这之后立即停止了，但吉莱斯皮夫妇的安心并未持续多久。

sentences.en: On Friday, August 19, 1977, five months after the first letter arrived in her mailbox,
sentences.zh: 1977年8月19日星期五，在第一封信送到她信箱五个月后，

sentences.en: Mary Gillespie and her sister-in-law, Karen Freshour, boarded a plane for a much-needed vacation in Florida.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·吉莱斯皮和她的嫂子卡伦·弗雷舒尔登上了前往佛罗里达度假的飞机，她们太需要这次假期了。

sentences.en: Mary's husband, Ron, remained in Circleville to look after the couple's children.
sentences.zh: 玛丽的丈夫罗恩留在瑟克尔维尔照顾家里的孩子。

sentences.en: That evening, Ron and his kids spent a quiet night at home.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，罗恩和他的孩子们在家度过了一个安静的夜晚。

sentences.en: Then, just after ten o'clock, the phone rang.
sentences.zh: 然后，刚过十点，电话铃响了。

sentences.en: Ron answered it.
sentences.zh: 罗恩接了电话。

sentences.en: He spent a few moments on the line before slamming the phone down angrily.
sentences.zh: 他在电话那头待了一会儿，然后愤怒地把电话摔了下来。

sentences.en: Ron retrieved his .22-caliber revolver.
sentences.zh: 罗恩取出了他的点二二口径左轮手枪。

sentences.en: He told his daughter, Tracy, that he had just received a call from the letter writer.
sentences.zh: 他告诉女儿特雷西，他刚接到写信人的电话。

sentences.en: Now, it seemed that the writer had escalated to phone calls.
sentences.zh: 现在，看来写信人已经升级到了打电话。

sentences.en: Ron planned to go and confront him.
sentences.zh: 罗恩打算去跟他对质。

sentences.en: He kissed Tracy on the top of her head and said he'd be back soon.
sentences.zh: 他在特雷西的头顶亲了一下，说他很快就会回来。

sentences.en: Then, Ron hopped into his red and white pickup truck and sped off down the rural Circleville Road.
sentences.zh: 然后，罗恩跳上他红白相间的皮卡车，沿着农村瑟克尔维尔路疾驰而去。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: “档案档案”稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持“档案档案”继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: At 10.30pm, about half an hour after Ron Gillespie received a call from the Circleville letter writer, the phone rang at the county sheriff's office.
sentences.zh: 晚上10点半，在罗恩·吉莱斯皮接到瑟克尔维尔写信人电话大约半小时后，县警长办公室的电话响了。

sentences.en: A frantic-sounding caller on the other end explained that he had just driven past a terrible accident on a road called Five Points Pike.
sentences.zh: 另一端一个声音慌乱的打电话者解释说，他刚开车经过一条名为“五点派克”的道路上的一起可怕事故。

sentences.en: Police rushed to the scene, which was seven miles from the Gillespie home.
sentences.zh: 警察赶到现场，该地点距离吉莱斯皮家有七英里。

sentences.en: There, they found Ron Gillespie's truck.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他们找到了罗恩·吉莱斯皮的卡车。

sentences.en: It had collided front-first into a tree at high speed.
sentences.zh: 它以高速度一头撞上了一棵树。

sentences.en: Ron hadn't been wearing a seatbelt and was ejected from the driver's seat into the windshield.
sentences.zh: 罗恩没有系安全带，从驾驶座被抛出撞到了挡风玻璃上。

sentences.en: He was rushed to hospital, but was pronounced dead on arrival from massive head trauma and internal injuries.
sentences.zh: 他被紧急送往医院，但因严重头部创伤和内伤被宣告不治身亡。

sentences.en: Ron's death appeared to be an accident.
sentences.zh: 罗恩的死似乎是一起意外。

sentences.en: He returned a blood alcohol level of 0.16%, which at the time was one and a half times the legal limit in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 他的血液酒精浓度为0.16%，当时这已经是俄亥俄州法定限制的1.5倍。

sentences.en: The area had no streetlights and it appeared as though Ron had missed the curve of the road, instead driving straight ahead and veering off course.
sentences.zh: 该地区没有路灯，罗恩似乎错过了道路的弯道，反而径直往前开并偏离了方向。

sentences.en: The coroner concluded no autopsy was necessary.
sentences.zh: 验尸官断定没有必要进行尸检。

sentences.en: Ron's devastated family was left with unanswered questions.
sentences.zh: 罗恩悲痛欲绝的家人留下了未解的谜团。

sentences.en: The revolver Ron had taken with him was discovered under his body.
sentences.zh: 罗恩随身携带的左轮手枪在他的尸体下被发现。

sentences.en: One of its bullets had been fired, but it was never located.
sentences.zh: 其中的一颗子弹被发射过，但那颗子弹一直没有找到。

sentences.en: Ron's family wondered if he had been in some sort of altercation, then gotten into a high-speed chase.
sentences.zh: 罗恩的家人想知道他是否与人发生了某种冲突，然后才卷入了一场高速追逐。

sentences.en: Although he'd been driving in the dark, Ron knew the area like the back of his hand.
sentences.zh: 尽管是在黑暗中开车，但罗恩对这片区域了如指掌。

sentences.en: He drove along Five Points Pike almost a daily.
sentences.zh: 他几乎每天都要开车经过五点派克路。

sentences.en: His loved ones couldn't accept that he would crash on a road he knew so well.
sentences.zh: 他的亲人们无法接受他会在一条如此熟悉的路上发生车祸。

sentences.en: Those who knew Ron were also confused by the blood alcohol report.
sentences.zh: 认识罗恩的人对血液酒精检测报告也感到迷惑不解。

sentences.en: Ron was not a heavy drinker.
sentences.zh: 罗恩并不是一个酗酒的人。

sentences.en: His children said he did not seem intoxicated when he left the house.
sentences.zh: 他的孩子说他离开家时看起来并没有喝醉。

sentences.en: Some members of his family also believed that one side of his pickup truck was peppered with bullet holes, though this was not mentioned in official police reports.
sentences.zh: 他家的一些成员还认为，他皮卡车的一侧布满了弹孔，尽管官方警方报告中并未提及这一点。

sentences.en: Former prison guard Paul Freshour was especially close to his brother-in-law.
sentences.zh: 前狱警保罗·弗雷肖尔与他的小舅子关系格外要好。

sentences.en: He told Sheriff Dwight Radcliffe that he believed foul play was involved.
sentences.zh: 他告诉警长德怀特·拉德克利夫，他相信其中涉及谋杀阴谋。

sentences.en: Sheriff Radcliffe initially took Paul's concerns seriously.
sentences.zh: 拉德克利夫警长最初认真对待了保罗的担忧。

sentences.en: He tracked down one potential suspect and questioned him extensively, but he was ruled out of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 他追查了一个潜在的嫌疑人并进行了详细盘问，但他被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: Following that lead, the sheriff reiterated the assumption that Ron's death was nothing more than a tragic accident.
sentences.zh: 顺着这条线索，警长重申了罗恩的死只是一起悲惨事故的假设。

sentences.en: Paul Freshour believed Sheriff Radcliffe knew more than he was letting on and accused him of covering up Ron's murder.
sentences.zh: 保罗·弗雷肖尔认为拉德克利夫警长知道的内情比透露出的要多，并指责他掩盖了罗恩的谋杀案。

sentences.en: Paul explained that the sheriff planned to run for the National Sheriff's Association presidency.
sentences.zh: 保罗解释说，警长计划竞选全国警长协会的主席。

sentences.en: Because of this, he couldn't afford to have a potential crime of such magnitude go unsolved in his county.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，他承担不起在他的辖区内发生如此重大的潜在犯罪却未侦破的后果。

sentences.en: What exactly happened to Ron Gillespie in the final moments of his life would remain unknown.
sentences.zh: 罗恩·吉尔斯皮在生命的最后时刻究竟发生了什么，至今仍是个谜。

sentences.en: But the crash appeared to unnerve the Circleville letter writer.
sentences.zh: 但这场车祸似乎让瑟克勒维尔的写信人感到不安。

sentences.en: After news of Ron's death spread through Circleville, the letters abruptly stopped.
sentences.zh: 在罗恩死讯在瑟克勒维尔传开后，信件戛然而止。

sentences.en: Ron Gillespie's death also affected the personal relationships of those closest to him.
sentences.zh: 罗恩·吉尔斯皮的死也影响了他身边至亲的人际关系。

sentences.en: In October 1982, Ron's sister Karen divorced her husband, Paul Freshour, after 20 years of marriage.
sentences.zh: 1982年10月，罗恩的姐姐凯伦与丈夫保罗·弗雷肖尔在结婚20年后离婚了。

sentences.en: Superintendent Gordon Massey and his wife also divorced, after she filed papers citing extreme cruelty and gross negligence of duty.
sentences.zh: 警监戈登·马西和他的妻子也在妻子提交指控其极端残忍和严重渎职的文件后离婚了。

sentences.en: Following his divorce, Gordon Massey began officially seeing Ron's widow, Mary Gillespie.
sentences.zh: 离婚后，戈登·马西开始正式与罗恩的遗孀玛丽·吉尔斯皮交往。

sentences.en: Despite the long-rumoured affair between the two, Mary was adamant their relationship did not start until this time.
sentences.zh: 尽管两人长期有绯闻传出，但玛丽坚称他们的关系直到此时才开始。

sentences.en: In the years that followed, Mary continued to work as a bus driver for the local school district.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几年里，玛丽继续在当地学区担任校车司机。

sentences.en: Yet, life didn't return to any semblance of normality.
sentences.zh: 然而，生活并没有恢复到任何正常的迹象。

sentences.en: In time, the Circleville letter writer began intermittently displaying signs around town again.
sentences.zh: 一段时间后，瑟克勒维尔的写信人开始断断续续地再次在镇上张贴标语。

sentences.en: Other residents also continued receiving nuisance mail, but the matter was not investigated further.
sentences.zh: 其他居民也继续收到滋扰信件，但此事没有得到进一步调查。

sentences.en: By December 1982, five years had passed since the death of Ron Gillespie, and Mary had received more than 30 letters and postcards from her unidentified harasser.
sentences.zh: 到1982年12月，罗恩·吉尔斯皮去世已经五年了，玛丽已经收到了她那未知的骚扰者发来的30多封信件和明信片。

sentences.en: Days before Christmas, she received yet another.
sentences.zh: 在圣诞节前几天，她又收到了一封。

sentences.en: This card contained an unusual threat.
sentences.zh: 这张卡片包含了一个不同寻常的威胁。

sentences.en: The writer wanted Mary to marry Gordon Massey within three months.
sentences.zh: 写信人要求玛丽在三个月内嫁给戈登·马西。

sentences.en: They added that if the couple wasn't married by March 1, 1983,
sentences.zh: 他们补充说，如果两人在1983年3月1日之前没有结婚，

sentences.en: Mary would have to visit all of the stops along her route to remove messages that would involve her now 13-year-old daughter, Tracy.
sentences.zh: 玛丽将不得不访问她路线上的所有站点以移除那些会牵连到她现年13岁女儿特雷西的信息。

sentences.en: Two months later, on Monday February 7, Mary was driving her bus near Five Point Pike, close to where her late husband Ron had crashed.
sentences.zh: 两个月后的2月7日星期一，玛丽正开着校车行驶在五点派克路附近，离她已故丈夫罗恩发生车祸的地方不远。

sentences.en: Mary was running late to collect her first busload of students that afternoon when she noticed a sign on a fence poSt.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，玛丽在赶着去接第一车学生时，注意到栅栏柱上有一个标语。

sentences.en: Written on a plank of 2x4 plywood, the sign featured a derogatory remark about her daughter, Tracy, and Gordon Massey.
sentences.zh: 标语写在一块两乘四英寸的胶合板木板上，上面包含了一条关于她的女儿特雷西和戈登·马西的贬损言论。

sentences.en: Mary stopped the bus and lifted the sign off the poSt.
sentences.zh: 玛丽把车停下，把标语从柱子上取了下来。

sentences.en: She put it on the seat beside her and continued on her way.
sentences.zh: 她把它放在身旁的座位上，继续赶路。

sentences.en: After Mary arrived home that day, she studied the sign more closely.
sentences.zh: 那天玛丽到家后，她更仔细地研究了这块标语。

sentences.en: Behind it was a black box made from corrugated cardboard.
sentences.zh: 标语后面是一个由瓦楞纸板制成的黑色盒子。

sentences.en: Mary tore open the top of the box.
sentences.zh: 玛丽撕开了盒子的顶部。

sentences.en: Inside, she saw a replica handgun held upright by styrofoam.
sentences.zh: 在里面，她看到了一把由泡沫塑料直立支撑的手枪复制品。

sentences.en: Mary deliberated whether to bother the sheriff's office with her discovery.
sentences.zh: 玛丽斟酌着是否要为自己的发现去麻烦警长办公室。

sentences.en: They were already well aware of the letters and signs she had been dealing with for years.
sentences.zh: 他们已经很清楚她多年来一直在处理的信件和标语。

sentences.en: However, given the implied threat that the replica gun represented,
sentences.zh: 然而，鉴于复制枪所代表的潜在威胁，

sentences.en: Mary decided to hand it over to authorities.
sentences.zh: 玛丽决定把它交给我们当局。

sentences.en: They established that the handgun wasn't a replica.
sentences.zh: 他们确定这把手枪不是复制品。

sentences.en: It was a live .25 calibre pistol in a crudely designed booby trap.
sentences.zh: 这是一个装在粗制滥造的诡雷里的真实.25口径手枪。

sentences.en: There was one bullet in the gun's chamber and another in the clip.
sentences.zh: 枪膛里有一颗子弹，弹夹里还有一颗。

sentences.en: A trip wire had been tied around the handle and trigger of the gun.
sentences.zh: 一根绊线绑在枪的把手和扳机上。

sentences.en: It was designed to go off when the sign was torn from the box.
sentences.zh: 它被设计成在标语从盒子上被扯下时引爆。

sentences.en: When attached to the post, the gun was positioned just over five feet from the ground.
sentences.zh: 当挂在柱子上时，这把枪的位置离地面刚好五英尺多一点。

sentences.en: Had Mary ripped the sign down instead of lifting the entire contraption off the fence post, she could have been killed.
sentences.zh: 如果玛丽当时是把标语扯下来，而不是把整个装置从栅栏柱上抬起来，她可能会丧命。

sentences.en: Whoever set up the trap had attempted to cover their tracks by filing the serial number off the gun.
sentences.zh: 设置这个陷阱的人试图通过锉掉枪上的序列号来掩盖行踪。

sentences.en: The pistol was sent to the Bureau of Criminal Analysis and through microscopic examination, investigators were able to piece together the serial number.
sentences.zh: 手枪被送往刑事分析局，通过显微镜检查，调查人员得以拼凑出序列号。

sentences.en: It was traced back to a man from Columbus named Wesley Wells.
sentences.zh: 它被追溯到哥伦布市的一个名叫韦斯利·韦尔斯的男子。

sentences.en: The next morning, Sheriff Dwight Radcliffe went to Wesley's residential address where he was met by his wife.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，德怀特·拉德克利夫警长前往韦斯利的住址，在那里遇到了他的妻子。

sentences.en: She advised that Wesley had left for his job at a local brewery.
sentences.zh: 她告知韦斯利已经去当地一家啤酒厂上班了。

sentences.en: The sheriff contacted Wesley's workplace and spoke to him over the phone.
sentences.zh: 警长联系了韦斯利的工作场所并通过电话与他交谈。

sentences.en: Wesley told the sheriff he had sold the gun to his work supervisor three months earlier.
sentences.zh: 韦斯利告诉警长，他在三个月前把枪卖给了他的工作主管。

sentences.en: The supervisor had wanted a gun for protection as his family was constantly being harassed.
sentences.zh: 主管因为家人不断受到骚扰，想要一把枪来防身。

sentences.en: While Wesley chatted with the sheriff, his supervisor stood nearby, listening in on the call.
sentences.zh: 正当韦斯利与警长闲聊时，他的主管站在附近，偷听着电话。

sentences.en: When the sheriff asked to speak with him, Wesley held out the phone, but his supervisor hastily walked away.
sentences.zh: 当警长提出要与他交谈时，韦斯利递出了电话，但他的主管匆忙走开了。

sentences.en: Sheriff Radcliffe then asked for the supervisor's name.
sentences.zh: 拉德克利夫警长随后询问了主管的名字。

sentences.en: The man who owned the pistol that almost killed Mary Gillespie was her brother-in-law, Paul Freshour.
sentences.zh: 拥有那把差点杀死玛丽·吉尔斯皮的手枪的男子正是她的姐夫保罗·弗雷肖尔。

sentences.en: Wesley was confused by Paul's strange behaviour.
sentences.zh: 韦斯利对保罗的奇怪行为感到困惑。

sentences.en: After his phone call with the sheriff, he confronted Paul and asked what had happened to the gun he had sold him.
sentences.zh: 在与警长通完电话后，他与保罗对质，询问他卖给他的枪怎么了。

sentences.en: Paul appeared nervous as he told Wesley it had gone missing.
sentences.zh: 保罗显得很紧张，告诉韦斯利枪不见了。

sentences.en: In the days that followed, Paul repeatedly approached Wesley to ask if he'd had any further contact with the sheriff about the gun.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，保罗多次找到韦斯利，询问他是否就这把枪与警长有过进一步的联系。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, investigators checked Paul Freshour's employment records.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，调查人员查阅了保罗·弗雷肖尔的工作记录。

sentences.en: They showed that Paul had requested a day off on the day that Mary Gillespie found the booby trap.
sentences.zh: 记录显示，在玛丽·吉尔斯皮发现诡雷的那天，保罗请了一天假。

sentences.en: A search of the brewery where Paul worked uncovered materials that matched those used to make the booby trap,
sentences.zh: 对保罗工作的啤酒厂的搜查发现了一些与制作诡雷相匹配的材料，

sentences.en: including a chalk box made of corrugated cardboard, twine, wire, and styrofoam.
sentences.zh: 包括由瓦楞纸板制成的粉笔盒、麻绳、铁丝和泡沫塑料。

sentences.en: When Paul was questioned, he admitted to owning the gun, but said it had been stolen from his garage sometime before the trap was set.
sentences.zh: 当保罗被审讯时，他承认拥有这件武器，但称在陷阱设置之前不知何时从他的车库里被偷了。

sentences.en: He had never reported it missing.
sentences.zh: 他从未报告它丢失。

sentences.en: Because the lettering on the booby trap sign was so similar to that of the Circleville letter writer,
sentences.zh: 由于诡雷标语上的字迹与瑟克勒维尔写信人的字迹非常相似，

sentences.en: the sheriff hoped that identifying whoever set the trap would weed out the writer once and for all.
sentences.zh: 警长希望找出设置陷阱的人能够一劳永逸地清除写信人。

sentences.en: On Friday, February 25, 1983, Paul Freshour was taken to the county sheriff's office for a series of handwriting tests.
sentences.zh: 1983年2月25日星期五，保罗·弗雷肖尔被带到县警长办公室进行一系列笔迹测试。

sentences.en: He willingly complied and also submitted to a polygraph test in an attempt to clear his name.
sentences.zh: 他自愿配合，并接受了测谎仪测试，试图洗清自己的嫌疑。

sentences.en: Although polygraphs are not a reliable indicator of guilt, the examiner concluded that Paul failed the test, indicating that he had set the booby trap.
sentences.zh: 尽管测谎仪不是内疚的可靠指标，但检查员得出结论认为保罗未能通过测试，表明他设置了诡雷。

sentences.en: His handwriting also bore incredible similarities to that of the Circleville letter writer.
sentences.zh: 他的笔迹也与瑟克勒维尔的写信人惊人地相似。

sentences.en: Paul was re-interviewed after this, and according to Sheriff Dwight Radcliffe, he admitted to writing about 50 of the Circleville letters.
sentences.zh: 在此之后，保罗再次接受了讯问，据德怀特·拉德克利夫警长称，他承认写了大约50封瑟克勒维尔的信件。

sentences.en: The sheriff could not ascertain Paul's motive.
sentences.zh: 警长无法确定保罗的动机。

sentences.en: On Thursday, March 3, 1983, Paul Freshour was arrested for the attempted murder of Mary Gillespie.
sentences.zh: 1983年3月3日星期四，保罗·弗雷肖尔因谋杀玛丽·吉尔斯皮未遂被捕。

sentences.en: He pleaded not guilty and was released on bond to await trial.
sentences.zh: 他坚称无罪并保释候审。

sentences.en: Paul was ordered not to send any more letters.
sentences.zh: 保罗被命令不得再寄信。

sentences.en: Soon, Sheriff Radcliffe and others reported receiving empty envelopes with writing scrawled over them.
sentences.zh: 不久，拉德克利夫警长和其他人报告说收到了上面乱涂乱画的空信封。

sentences.en: These were not investigated.
sentences.zh: 这些没有受到调查。

sentences.en: In early May 1983, Paul Freshour voluntarily admitted himself to a mental health facility and entered a plea of innocent by reason of insanity.
sentences.zh: 1983年5月上旬，保罗·弗雷肖尔自愿住进了一家精神健康机构，并以精神失常为由进行了无罪抗辩。

sentences.en: He claimed he was only insane when the booby trap was set.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己只有在设置诡雷时精神失常。

sentences.en: At all other times, he was of sound mind.
sentences.zh: 在所有其他时间里，他精神都很正常。

sentences.en: A court-ordered evaluation found that Paul was fit to stand trial, and one month before the trial began, he withdrew his earlier insanity plea.
sentences.zh: 法院下令进行的评估发现保罗适合接受审判，在审判开始前一个月，他撤回了早先的精神失常抗辩。

sentences.en: Paul publicly denied the sheriff's claim that he had admitted to writing 50 of the letters, saying it was completely untrue.
sentences.zh: 保罗公开否认警长关于他承认写了50封信的说法，称这完全是子虚乌有。

sentences.en: He also said that if he were to set a booby trap to harm someone, he was smart enough to use a gun that couldn't be traced back to him.
sentences.zh: 他还说，如果他要设下诡雷去伤害某人，他足够聪明，会使用一把无法追查到他身上的枪。

sentences.en: Paul Freshour's trial began in October 1983.
sentences.zh: 保罗·弗雷肖尔的审判于1983年10月开始。

sentences.en: Because he had not been charged with being the Circleville letter writer, he was on trial solely for the attempted murder of Mary Gillespie.
sentences.zh: 由于他没有被指控为瑟克勒维尔的写信人，他受审的唯一罪名是谋杀玛丽·吉尔斯皮未遂。

sentences.en: However, 39 letters were ruled as admissible to give context and background to the crime.
sentences.zh: 然而，39封信被裁定为可以采纳，以便为犯罪提供背景和脉络。

sentences.en: Because no fingerprints or other physical evidence were ever found on the booby trap, the trial was purely based on circumstantial evidence.
sentences.zh: 由于在诡雷上从未找到指纹或其他物证，审判完全基于间接证据。

sentences.en: It was revealed that rather than take a sample of Paul Freshour's natural handwriting,
sentences.zh: 据透露，德怀特·拉德克利夫警长并没有提取保罗·弗雷肖尔的自然笔迹样本，

sentences.en: Sheriff Dwight Radcliffe had given him a letter from the Circleville letter writer and asked him to copy it as closely as possible.
sentences.zh: 而是给了他一封来自瑟克勒维尔写信人的信，并要求他尽可能仔细地抄写。

sentences.en: But the sheriff said he'd also dictated excerpts for Paul to write down, and these were the samples that were analysed.
sentences.zh: 但警长说他也口述了一些摘录让保罗写下来，而这些才是被分析的样本。

sentences.en: A handwriting expert compared paperwork from Paul's workplace to the Circleville letters and believed they were a match.
sentences.zh: 一位笔迹专家将保罗工作场所的文书工作与瑟克勒维尔的信件进行了比较，并认为它们相匹配。

sentences.en: Even a handwriting expert hired by the defence agreed that Paul Freshour was the Circleville letter writer and the author of the sign on the booby trap.
sentences.zh: 甚至连辩方聘请的一位笔迹专家也同意保罗·弗雷肖尔就是瑟克勒维尔的写信人以及诡雷上标语的作者。

sentences.en: Mary Gillespie testified that she'd never suspected Paul Freshour could be the Circleville letter writer.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·吉尔斯皮作证说，她从未怀疑过保罗·弗雷肖尔会是瑟克勒维尔的写信人。

sentences.en: After all, Paul had tried to help Mary from receiving letters.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，保罗曾试图帮助玛丽免受信件骚扰。

sentences.en: He was also close to Ron Gillespie and pushed police to view his brother-in-law's death as a murder.
sentences.zh: 他也与罗恩·吉尔斯皮关系密切，并敦促警方将他小舅子的死视为谋杀。

sentences.en: But Mary recalled a conversation she had with Paul's ex-wife, Karen, in August 1982.
sentences.zh: 但玛丽回想起她在1982年8月与保罗的前妻凯伦有过的一次对话。

sentences.en: Karen had seen letters floating in their toilet, with handwriting that bore a strong resemblance to the Circleville writer.
sentences.zh: 凯伦曾看到信件漂浮在他们的马桶里，其笔迹与瑟克勒维尔的写信人有着惊人的相似之处。

sentences.en: Paul Freshour's defence team painted him as a rational and innocent man.
sentences.zh: 保罗·弗雷肖尔的辩护团队将他描绘成一个理智且无辜的人。

sentences.en: With a master's degree in industrial management, Paul's writing style was nothing like the misspelled and grammatically incorrect Circleville letters.
sentences.zh: 凭借工业管理硕士学位，保罗的写作风格与拼写错误且语法不正确的瑟克勒维尔信件截然不同。

sentences.en: He had no prior criminal record and had a well-paying job which he wouldn't risk by trying to kill his former sister-in-law.
sentences.zh: 他没有前科，且有一份高薪工作，他不会为了试图杀死前小姨子而冒这个险。

sentences.en: While the materials used to make the booby trap were found at Paul's workplace, his lawyers argued that these were common and found in every home.
sentences.zh: 虽然制作诡雷的材料是在保罗的工作场所被发现的，但他的律师辩称这些都很常见，在每个家庭里都能找到。

sentences.en: Paul said he had taken time off work on the day the trap was found because he was getting work done on his home and needed to be present.
sentences.zh: 保罗说他在发现陷阱的那天请假是因为他家里在进行装修需要他在场。

sentences.en: Multiple people testified to seeing Paul at his house.
sentences.zh: 多名证人作证说看到保罗在家。

sentences.en: The trial lasted four days.
sentences.zh: 审判持续了四天。

sentences.en: After two and a half hours of deliberation, the jury returned with a verdict.
sentences.zh: 经过两个半小时的商议，陪审团带着裁决回来了。

sentences.en: For the attempted murder of Mary Gillespie, Paul Freshour was found guilty.
sentences.zh: 因谋杀玛丽·吉尔斯皮未遂罪，保罗·弗雷肖尔被判有罪。

sentences.en: As he listened to the judge sentence him to between seven and twenty-five years in prison, the look on Paul's face was one of utter shock.
sentences.zh: 当他听着法官判处他七年至二十五年监禁时，保罗脸上的表情震惊无比。

sentences.en: After Paul Freshour was sent to prison, everyone assumed that the Circleville letters would stop.
sentences.zh: 在保罗·弗雷肖尔被送进监狱后，所有人都以为瑟克勒维尔的信件会停止。

sentences.en: However, soon after he was incarcerated, the town's residents began reporting that they were receiving letters in the all-too-familiar blocky writing.
sentences.zh: 然而，就在他入狱后不久，镇上的居民开始报告说他们收到了带有那熟悉得不能再熟悉的方块字体的信件。

sentences.en: Sheriff Dwight Radcliffe was certain Paul was somehow smuggling the letters out of prison.
sentences.zh: 德怀特·拉德克利夫警长确信保罗以某种方式把信件从监狱里偷运了出去。

sentences.en: He ordered Paul to be sent to solitary confinement.
sentences.zh: 他下令将保罗送入单人牢房。

sentences.en: His mail was censored and he was strip-searched before and after visits.
sentences.zh: 他的信件受到审查，并且在探视前后都要被脱衣搜身。

sentences.en: Sheriff Radcliffe was certain this would stop the letters as there was absolutely no way Paul could send them in these conditions.
sentences.zh: 拉德克利夫警长确信这会阻止信件，因为保罗在这些条件下绝对没有办法寄出它们。

sentences.en: However, letters continued to trickle in to Circleville residents.
sentences.zh: 然而，信件仍然源源不断地流入瑟克勒维尔居民手中。

sentences.en: They were postmarked from Columbus.
sentences.zh: 它们的邮戳来自哥伦布市。

sentences.en: Paul was incarcerated in
sentences.zh: 保罗被关押在

sentences.en: Lima, a city 200 miles away.
sentences.zh: 利马，一个200英里外的城市。

sentences.en: An internal investigation was held but couldn't explain how Paul was smuggling the letters out.
sentences.zh: 内部调查展开了，但无法解释保罗是如何把信件偷运出去的。

sentences.en: Sheriff Radcliffe thought a copycat could be responsible, but the similarities between the latest letters and the original ones were startling.
sentences.zh: 拉德克利夫警长认为可能是模仿者所为，但最新信件与原件之间的相似之处令人震惊。

sentences.en: In 1990, Paul Freshour became eligible for parole after serving seven years.
sentences.zh: 1990年，服刑七年的保罗·弗雷肖尔获得了假释资格。

sentences.en: Prior to his hearing, the writer upped their game, sending more letters than ever before.
sentences.zh: 在听证会之前，写信人加大了力度，寄出的信件比以往任何时候都多。

sentences.en: Despite Paul being a model prisoner, his parole was denied due to the board believing he was behind the letters.
sentences.zh: 尽管保罗是一名模范囚犯，但由于委员会相信他是信件的幕后黑手，他的假释申请被拒绝了。

sentences.en: A few days after his hearing, Paul Freshour received his own letter.
sentences.zh: 在他的听证会几天后，保罗·弗雷肖尔收到了他自己的信。

sentences.en: Postmarked from
sentences.zh: 邮戳来自

sentences.en: Columbus, it contained all the hallmarks of the Circleville letter writer.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布，它带有瑟克勒维尔写信人的所有特征。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 上面写着，

sentences.en: Freshour.
sentences.zh: 弗雷肖尔。

sentences.en: Now when are you going to believe you aren't getting out of there?
sentences.zh: 现在你什么时候才会相信你离不开那里？

sentences.en: I told you two years ago, when we set em up, they stay set up.
sentences.zh: 两年前我就告诉过你，当我们把它们设下时，它们就会一直留在那里。

sentences.en: Don't you listen at all?
sentences.zh: 你根本不听吗？

sentences.en: No one wants you out.
sentences.zh: 没人想让你出来。

sentences.en: No one.
sentences.zh: 没有一个。

sentences.en: The joke is on you.
sentences.zh: 笑话落在了你身上。

sentences.en: Ha ha.
sentences.zh: 哈哈。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 案卷档案将很快回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持案卷档案继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: In December 1986, Paul Freshour spoke to a reporter from the Columbus
sentences.zh: 1986年12月，保罗·弗雷绍尔在狱中接受了

sentences.en: Dispatch from jail.
sentences.zh: 《哥伦布快讯报》记者的采访。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说：

sentences.en: I'm not a criminal and I'm not crazy, but I'm a convict now and I don't have much credibility.
sentences.zh: “我不是罪犯，也没有发疯，但我现在是个囚犯，而且没什么公信力了。”

sentences.en: People tend not to believe convicts.
sentences.zh: “人们往往不会相信囚犯。”

sentences.en: Sheriff Dwight Radcliffe was quoted in the same article as saying, I think we got the right man.
sentences.zh: 德怀特·拉德克利夫警长在同一篇文章中被引述称：“我认为我们抓对人了。”

sentences.en: I know what Freshour wants.
sentences.zh: “我知道弗雷绍尔想要什么。”

sentences.en: He's trying to say, look, I'm in prison, but the letters have never stopped.
sentences.zh: “他试图说，看呐，我在监狱里，但那些信件从未停止过。”

sentences.en: All he wants is publicity.
sentences.zh: “他想要的只是曝光度。”

sentences.en: In 1993, producers of the popular television program Unsolved Mysteries announced their intention to cover the Circleville letter writer.
sentences.zh: 1993年，热门电视节目《未解之谜》的制作人宣布他们打算报道瑟克尔维尔信件的书信人。

sentences.en: As production was about to begin, a postcard made from manila cardboard arrived at the show's offices.
sentences.zh: 正当制作即将开始时，节目办公室收到了一张用马尼拉硬纸板制作的明信片。

sentences.en: In familiar blocky black lettering were the words,
sentences.zh: 上面是用熟悉的块状黑体字写成的话：

sentences.en: forget Circleville, Ohio.
sentences.zh: “忘了俄亥俄州的瑟克尔维尔吧。”

sentences.en: Forget Sheriff Radcliffe.
sentences.zh: “忘了拉德克利夫警长吧。”

sentences.en: If you come to Ohio, you sickos will pay.
sentences.zh: “如果你们来俄亥俄州，你们这些变态会付出代价的。”

sentences.en: The Circleville writer.
sentences.zh: “瑟克尔维尔的写信人。”

sentences.en: The producers ignored the postcard and continued filming as planned.
sentences.zh: 制作人们无视了这张明信片，并按计划继续拍摄。

sentences.en: Paul Freshour was eventually paroled from prison after 10 years and appeared on the segment.
sentences.zh: 保罗·弗雷绍尔在服刑10年后最终获假释出狱，并出现在了这期节目中。

sentences.en: He staunchly maintained his innocence and urged investigators to look further into the case.
sentences.zh: 他坚决坚称自己无罪，并敦促调查人员进一步深入调查此案。

sentences.en: Mary Gillespie and Karen Freshour declined to appear on the program.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·吉利斯派和凯伦·弗雷绍尔拒绝出现在节目中。

sentences.en: If Paul Freshour was innocent as he had claimed, then the question remained, who else could have been the Circleville letter writer?
sentences.zh: 如果保罗·弗雷绍尔正如他所声称的那样无罪，那么问题依然存在：究竟谁还可能是瑟克尔维尔的写信人？

sentences.en: The situation had unfolded from allegations of infidelity between Mary Gillespie and Gordon Massey.
sentences.zh: 局势的恶化源于玛丽·吉利斯派和戈登·马西之间存在婚外情的指控。

sentences.en: Gordon's son, William, was 19 years old when the letters began, and some were even signed with his name.
sentences.zh: 戈登的儿子威廉在信件开始时19岁，其中有些信件甚至还签了他的名字。

sentences.en: If William was aware of the alleged affair between his father and Mary, this might have given him a motive.
sentences.zh: 如果威廉知道他父亲和玛丽之间的所谓绯闻，这可能会给他提供一个动机。

sentences.en: However, investigators concluded he was most likely being framed by the real culprit.
sentences.zh: 然而，调查人员断定他极有可能是被真凶陷害了。

sentences.en: Some have speculated that it was Paul Freshour who was framed.
sentences.zh: 有人推测，被陷害的人其实是保罗·弗雷绍尔。

sentences.en: Four months before Mary Gillespie discovered the booby trap, Karen and Paul Freshour divorced.
sentences.zh: 在玛丽·吉利斯派发现绊网陷阱的四个月前，凯伦和保罗·弗雷绍尔离婚了。

sentences.en: Paul was granted custody of their daughter as well as the family home.
sentences.zh: 保罗获得了他们女儿的监护权以及家庭住宅。

sentences.en: Karen moved into a trailer on Mary's property.
sentences.zh: 凯伦搬进了玛丽房产内的一辆拖车里。

sentences.en: Had Karen sought revenge against her ex-husband for losing out in their divorce settlement?
sentences.zh: 凯伦是否因为在离婚协议中失利而对前夫展开报复？

sentences.en: When Paul was incarcerated, Karen received parental custody and moved back into the home.
sentences.zh: 当保罗入狱时，凯伦获得了抚养权并搬回了家中。

sentences.en: Journalist and author Martin Yant covered the case extensively and appeared on the Unsolved Mysteries segment.
sentences.zh: 记者兼作家马丁·扬特对该案进行了广泛报道，并出现在了《未解之谜》的节目中。

sentences.en: He said that when he reviewed the case files, he found some unreleased information.
sentences.zh: 他说，当他审查案件档案时，他发现了一些未公开的信息。

sentences.en: 20 minutes before Mary Gillespie noticed the sign with the trap, another bus driver had driven by the same area.
sentences.zh: 在玛丽·吉利斯派注意到带有陷阱的标语牌前20分钟，另一名公交车司机曾开车经过同一区域。

sentences.en: She noticed a yellow El Camino parked in the spot where the sign would be placed.
sentences.zh: 她注意到一辆黄色的El Camino轿车停在那个后来放置标语牌的地方。

sentences.en: Standing next to the car was a man who turned away as the bus driver passed.
sentences.zh: 车旁站着一个男人，当公交车司机驶过时，他转过脸去。

sentences.en: He was tall with a heavy build and sandy coloured hair, in stark contrast to Paul Freshour who was short with black hair.
sentences.zh: 他身材高大魁梧，有着沙黄色头发，这与身材矮小、黑发保罗·弗雷绍尔形成了鲜明对比。

sentences.en: It was later revealed that Karen Freshour had a boyfriend who matched this description and drove an El Camino.
sentences.zh: 后来证实，凯伦·弗雷绍尔有一个符合这一体貌特征并开着El Camino的男友。

sentences.en: Whoever the Circleville writer was, they wanted attention brought to Karen Freshour.
sentences.zh: 无论瑟克尔维尔的写信人是谁，他们都希望把注意力引向凯伦·弗雷绍尔。

sentences.en: A letter the elusive writer addressed to Sheriff Dwight Radcliffe in 1983 said,
sentences.zh: 这位行踪诡秘的写信人在1983年寄给德怀特·拉德克利夫警长的一封信中写道：

sentences.en: It was signed with the name Karen Freshour.
sentences.zh: 信的署名是凯伦·弗雷绍尔。

sentences.en: Following his release from prison, Paul Freshour wrote to the FBI attaching more than 150 pages of evidence that he believed pointed to his innocence.
sentences.zh: 出狱后，保罗·弗雷绍尔致信联邦调查局，附上了150多页他认为指向自己无罪的证据。

sentences.en: Whoever they were, it was clear that the Circleville writer had inside knowledge about the town's residence.
sentences.zh: 无论他们是谁，很明显瑟克尔维尔的写信人对镇上的居民了如指掌。

sentences.en: In one letter, the writer accused the county coroner, Dr Ray Carroll, of molesting children.
sentences.zh: 在一封信中，写信人指控县验尸官雷·卡罗尔博士虐待儿童。

sentences.en: Later, in December 1983, Dr Carroll was charged with a range of offences, including corruption of a minor and indecent exposure.
sentences.zh: 后来，在1983年12月，卡罗尔博士被控多项罪名，包括败坏未成年人风化和猥亵暴露。

sentences.en: In August 1980, three years after the Circleville letters started, a 25-year-old Circleville Elementary School teacher named Vicky Coke was reported missing by her family.
sentences.zh: 1980年8月，即瑟克尔维尔信件开始三年后，25岁的瑟克尔维尔小学教师维基·科克的家人报案称她失踪了。

sentences.en: There were no signs of forced entry or assault in Vicky's apartment, and her car was found a half a mile away, unlocked.
sentences.zh: 维基的公寓里没有遭到强行闯入或袭击的迹象，她的车在半英里外被发现，且没有锁门。

sentences.en: A month later, a township worker was mowing an area among cornfields 35 miles north from Vicky's home.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，一名乡镇工人在距离维基家以北35英里的玉米地中割草。

sentences.en: They soon stumbled across Vicky's body, wearing the same clothing she was last seen alive in.
sentences.zh: 他们很快无意中发现了维基的尸体，她身上穿着她生前最后一次被人看到时穿的衣服。

sentences.en: Although investigators concluded her death was the result of homicide, they failed to identify a suspect and the case went cold.
sentences.zh: 尽管调查人员断定她的死是谋杀结果，但他们未能确定嫌疑人，案件也成了悬案。

sentences.en: Soon after Vicky's body was discovered, the Circleville letter writer began sending letters about the case.
sentences.zh: 维基的尸体被发现后不久，瑟克尔维尔的写信人开始发送有关此案的信件。

sentences.en: They claimed that Vicky Coke had been having an affair with a local prosecutor and was pregnant with his baby.
sentences.zh: 他们声称维基·科克与当地一名检察官有染，并怀上了他的孩子。

sentences.en: The writer accused the prosecutor of killing Vicky to keep the matter quiet.
sentences.zh: 写信人指控检察官为了保持此事秘密而杀害了维基。

sentences.en: The writer threatened to dig up a deceased baby's bones and mail them to random people if a thorough investigation into Vicky's murder wasn't completed.
sentences.zh: 写信人威胁说，如果不彻底调查维基的谋杀案，就要挖出一个已故婴儿的骨头并邮寄给随机的人。

sentences.en: The theft of an infant's remains from a local graveyard was reported soon after.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，当地墓地发生了一起婴儿遗体被盗的报告。

sentences.en: Afterwards, letters were delivered to Sheriff Dwight Radcliffe with fine white powder inside.
sentences.zh: 此后，寄给德怀特·拉德克利夫警长的信件里装有细白粉末。

sentences.en: The Circleville writer claimed the powder was the baby's ground-up bones.
sentences.zh: 瑟克尔维尔的写信人声称这些粉末是婴儿被磨碎的骨头。

sentences.en: But testing revealed it was actually arsenic.
sentences.zh: 但检测结果表明，实际上那是砒霜。

sentences.en: Online, rumours abound that the Circleville letter writer was correct in his assertion that Vicky Coke was carrying the prosecutor's child,
sentences.zh: 在网络上，到处流传着这样一种谣言：瑟克尔维尔的写信人关于维基·科克怀了检察官孩子的断言是正确的，

sentences.en: despite there being no evidence that she was pregnant at all.
sentences.zh: 尽管没有任何证据表明她曾怀过孕。

sentences.en: Others have considered the possibility that Vicky crossed paths with the serial killer that was active in the area at the time.
sentences.zh: 其他人则考虑到这样一种可能性：维基在当时与活跃在该地区的连环杀手狭路相逢。

sentences.en: The murder of Vicky Coke remained Circleville's only unsolved homicide.
sentences.zh: 维基·科克的谋杀案仍然是瑟克尔维尔唯一未破的凶杀案。

sentences.en: Paul Freshour died in June 2012 at the age of 70, maintaining his innocence to the very end.
sentences.zh: 保罗·弗雷绍尔于2012年6月去世，享年70岁，至死坚称自己无罪。

sentences.en: Many who knew Paul could not believe he was the Circleville letter writer, describing him as a kind, softly-spoken man.
sentences.zh: 许多认识保罗的人都不相信他是瑟克尔维尔的写信人，他们形容他是一个善良、轻声细语的人。

sentences.en: More than a thousand letters were received by Circleville residents during the writer's 16-year campaign.
sentences.zh: 在该写信人长达16年的活动期间，瑟克尔维尔居民收到了1000多封信件。

sentences.en: The final one ever sent was the one directed at the Unsolved Mysteries producers.
sentences.zh: 寄出的最后封信是针对《未解之谜》制作人的那封。

sentences.en: 103 postcards and 391 letters were found to match to Paul Freshour's writing.
sentences.zh: 经查证，有103张明信片和391封信件与保罗·弗雷绍尔的笔迹相符。

sentences.en: Handwriting experts also linked Paul to the sign on the booby trap.
sentences.zh: 笔迹专家还将保罗与绊网陷阱上的标语牌联系起来。

sentences.en: Yet, while some experts believe in the strength of handwriting analysis, others dismiss it as junk science.
sentences.zh: 然而，虽然一些专家相信笔迹分析的准确性，但另一些人则将其斥为伪科学。

sentences.en: According to the television series 48 Hours, a dozen letters written while Paul was incarcerated were revealed to have his fingerprints on them.
sentences.zh: 据电视节目《48小时》报道，保罗在服刑期间写的一打信件上被发现留有他的指纹。

sentences.en: Investigators never solved how he could have smuggled these letters out of prison.
sentences.zh: 调查人员始终没有解开他是如何将这些信件走私出监狱的谜团。

sentences.en: We'll receive some thanks for sharing their attention.
sentences.zh: 我们将会因分享他们的关注而获得一些感谢。

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
